topic.source_contract: tree and woodland inventory, legal protection, ancient status, arboricultural effects, avoidance and mitigation, felling permission, restocking, implementation and monitoring evidence

scope_guards: A tree canopy map is not treated as a verified tree survey.
An ancient woodland inventory polygon is not treated as proof of condition at every point.
A planning permission is not automatically a felling licence.
A felling application is not treated as an issued licence.
A TPO search is not treated as consent for works.
A compensation proposal is not treated as replacement of irreplaceable habitat.
Planting is not treated as established woodland without monitoring.
No score or promotion is written without exact inventory, protection, permissions, works, restocking and monitored establishment.
